title: Technical Account Manager
description:
Technical Account Manager – Telecom Software

Iquall es una compañía de software especializada en automatización y transformación de redes para operadores de telecomunicaciones. Trabajamos con grandes carriers, ayudándolos a modernizar su operación, automatizar procesos críticos y evolucionar la gestión de la red hacia modelos más eficientes y autónomos. Somos una empresa con fuerte ADN técnico, pero con visión comercial y foco en crecimiento sostenible. Nuestro modelo combina coherencia comercial, credibilidad técnica y ejecución sólida.

Buscamos un Technical Account Manager (TAM) con fuerte perfil estratégico y orientación al cliente para gestionar cuentas clave (Tier-1) dentro del sector telecom. El TAM es responsable de gestionar integralmente la cuenta desde lo técnico-comercial. No es un rol de soporte ni de delivery operativo. Es quien entiende los desafíos del cliente, influye en su planificación futura y construye oportunidades sostenibles. El rol combina visión técnica, desarrollo de negocio y acompañamiento post-venta para asegurar la generación de valor continuo y la adopción de nuestras soluciones de automatización.

Principales Responsabilidades

Gestión Estratégica y Desarrollo de Negocio:

  • Comprender la estructura tecnológica, operativa y presupuestaria del cliente, alineando nuestras soluciones con sus iniciativas de transformación digital y eficiencia operativa.
  • Detectar iniciativas y problemas estructurales antes de que se conviertan en procesos formales de licitación (RFPs).
  • Generar proactivamente oportunidades de upselling y cross-selling sobre la base instalada ("budget fishing").
  • Influir en la planificación futura y las líneas presupuestarias del cliente.

Venta Consultiva (Soluciones Estándar):

  • Diseñar y presentar de forma autónoma propuestas técnico-comerciales cuando la solución se base en el portafolio existente de Iquall.
  • Traducir capacidades complejas de producto en soluciones claras, viables y con sentido económico para el cliente.

Relacionamiento y Evangelización:

  • Construir vínculos sólidos y gestionar múltiples stakeholders dentro de organizaciones complejas, manteniendo credibilidad tanto frente a equipos de ingeniería/operativos como áreas ejecutivas (C-Level).
  • Orquestar workshops y sesiones ejecutivas ("Overview Demos") para mostrar el arte de lo posible e impulsar la adopción de nuevas funcionalidades.
  • Continuidad Post-Venta (Value Delivery):
  • Asegurar la correcta implementación y adopción de las soluciones vendidas.
  • Coordinar la transición hacia la ejecución junto a los Project Managers (PMs) y Delivery, identificando riesgos tempranos, pero sin gestionar la operación directamente.

Requisitos Excluyentes:

  • Experiencia: 5+ años en roles de gestión técnica de cuentas, consultoría técnica o ingeniería de ventas (Pre-Sales) con fuerte componente relacional y orientados a resultados comerciales.
  • Industria: Experiencia sólida trabajando con operadores de telecomunicaciones (Tier-1 preferentemente), conocimiento de operaciones, arquitectura de red (fija, móvi, Cloudl, ej. FTTH, 4G/5G), y plataformas OSS/BSS.
  • Formación: Título universitario en Ingeniería (Telecomunicaciones, Sistemas, Electrónica) o carrera técnica equivalente.
  • Idiomas: Dominio fluido de inglés y español.
  • Habilidades Técnicas: Conocimiento conceptual de software, modelos de despliegue (Cloud, SaaS, On-premise), APIs e integración. Familiaridad con los marcos de trabajo de la industria (ej. estándares TM Forum, eTOM, Open APIs). Entendimiento suficiente para influir técnicamente sin necesidad de ejecutar configuraciones profundas (hands-on).
  • Competencias: Comunicación técnica a nivel ejecutivo, capacidad para traducir problemas operativos en impacto de negocio, pensamiento estratégico a largo plazo y excelentes habilidades de negociación.
  • Disponibilidad: Para viajar atendiendo el territorio asignado.

Deseable

  • Experiencia previa y cartera de contactos en cuentas Tier-1 de la región.
  • Certificaciones en gestión de proyectos (PMP o similares) o Metodologías Agile.
  • Formación de posgrado en gestión tecnológica o negocios.

Qué Ofrecemos

  • Rol estratégico con impacto directo en el crecimiento de la compañía.
  • Trabajo con operadores de telecomunicaciones de primer nivel.
  • Participación en proyectos de automatización reales y de vanguardia.
  • Espacio para crecer profesionalmente combinando tecnología de alto nivel y negocio.

- Kubernetes avançado: Helm, ArgoCD/Flux, OPA/Gatekeeper, Istio/Linkerd

- Redes: arquitetura Hub Spoke, DNS, VPN, Jumpserver, Conditional Forwards

- Terraform: módulos, remote backends, workspaces e boas práticas de IaC

- Containerização: Docker multi-stage builds, otimização de imagens, image promotion

title: Latam-Focused Research Intern
description:
About BCP Securities Group

Founded in 1989, BCP Securities, Inc. is an American brokerage and investment bank focused on fixed income in emerging markets. Headquartered in Greenwich, Connecticut, with offices in strategic cities such as Rio de Janeiro, Miami, Los Angeles, Madrid, Mexico City, and Singapore, BCP is a global reference in customized financial solutions. Recognized for its excellence and ethical commitment, the company offers innovative and effective services to meet the needs of clients around the world.

Workplace: Rio de Janeiro, 100% on-site Contract Type: Internship

Position Description

We are looking for a motivated and curious Research Intern to join our Research team, with a focus on Latin America's, particularly Argentina's, macroeconomic and financial environment. This position is ideal for students who are eager to learn and develop their skills in economic and financial research.

The selected candidate must be native or fluent in Spanish and English (mandatory) and will support the research team in conducting studies, preparing financial reports, and assisting senior analysts in day-to-day activities.

Please note: Resumes will only be accepted if written English. Applications submitted in Portuguese will not be considered.

Main Responsibilities

· Support the preparation of financial reports on companies and the monitoring of key economic and financial indicators.

· Assist in preparing summaries and basic analyses of market trends, economic projections, and corporate earnings.

· Help monitor economic events, public policy changes, and macroeconomic data that may impact financial markets.

· Track the performance and movements of financial assets.

· Assist in the development of financial models for company valuation, under the guidance of senior analysts.

· Support data collection, organization, and basic analysis.

· Assist with administrative and operational tasks such as organizing meetings, reports, and presentation materials.

· Collaborate in the preparation of materials for internal use and for investor or market communications.

Requirements

· Fluent Spanish and fluent English (mandatory).

· Currently pursuing a degree in Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, Accounting, or related fields.

· Basic understanding of financial concepts such as financial statements, company valuation, and financial instruments.

· Ability to read and interpret financial statements and corporate reports.

· Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with attention to detail.

· Good Excel skills (formulas, basic financial modeling).

· Clear and structured written communication skills.

· Willingness to learn, curiosity about financial markets, and interest in economic trends and global events.

Differentials

· Previous internship or academic experience in finance, economics, or capital markets.

· Familiarity with financial information platforms such as Bloomberg or Reuters.

· Knowledge of basic programming or data analysis tools (e.G., Python, VBA, Power BI).

Benefits

· Hands-on learning experience in a global company with a strong presence in the fixed income market.

· Exposure to macroeconomic analysis, company research, and financial markets in LatAm.

· Continuous learning, mentoring, and professional development.

· Collaborative, dynamic, and supportive work environment.

title: Gerente De Aterro Sanitário
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Concessionária

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1o de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Conduzir análises de viabilidade técnica e econômica para expansão de capacidade, purificação para biometano ou ampliação da geração de energia.
  • Profissional com experiência comprovada em gás combustível de fonte renovável e Unidade de disposição final de resíduos sólidos, com atuação direta na gestão, monitoramento e análise de indicadores operacionais e ambientais do sistema de extração e aproveitamento energético do gás gerado por digestão anaeróbia.
  • Sólida vivência em sítios de destinação final ambientalmente controlados, incluindo controle de eficiência de captação, monitoramento de vazão, pressão, teor de metano (CH4), oxigênio (O2) e demais parâmetros críticos de desempenho.

title: Sr. Backend Engineer
description:
About You

You are a senior-level Backend Engineer (Node.Js) who thrives in challenging environments and enjoys taking ownership of complex systems to transform them into secure, scalable, and production-ready solutions.

You are highly hands-on and comfortable working with evolving or partially structured codebases. You can quickly assess risks, identify critical issues, and execute remediation strategies under tight timelines. You value clean code, security best practices, and reliable system behavior.

You collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, communicate technical challenges clearly, and play a key role in stabilizing applications and restoring confidence in production systems. You are motivated by making a tangible impact and contributing to the successful relaunch and future scalability of a critical platform.

You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in backend development using Node.Js.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong experience working with REST APIs and third-party integrations.
  • Proven experience handling legacy systems, codebase audits, or technical recovery scenarios.
  • Solid understanding of application security best practices, including secure handling of sensitive data.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS environments and services.
  • Experience setting up or troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong experience working with PostgreSQL databases (RDS preferred).
  • Familiarity with proxies, CORS, and common web security vulnerabilities (e.G., SSRF).
  • Ability to work in fast-paced environments with ambiguous or incomplete documentation.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to prioritize issues based on business impact.
  • Experience collaborating with mobile teams (React Native is a plus).
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.

You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Take ownership of the Node.Js backend and perform a full technical assessment of the codebase.
  • Identify and remediate critical security vulnerabilities and insecure integrations.
  • Refactor unstable or low-quality code to improve reliability, maintainability, and performance.
  • Stabilize core application flows required for production readiness.
  • Re-establish codebase ownership by organizing and migrating repositories within the client environment.
  • Analyze and restore CI/CD pipelines across repositories and environments.
  • Set up and validate staging environments to support testing and release processes.
  • Audit and stabilize third-party integrations such as payments and external platforms.
  • Collaborate with QA and stakeholders to validate functionality and prioritize fixes.
  • Support release readiness and launch execution ensuring system stability.
  • Enforce a feature-freeze approach focused on stabilization and critical fixes.
  • Contribute to defining a post-launch roadmap to support scalability and future development.
  • Continuously improve system security, performance, and operational stability.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Node.Js backend development.
  • Experience working with legacy systems, system stabilization, or technical recovery projects.
  • Strong experience with AWS, CI/CD pipelines, and PostgreSQL.
  • Solid understanding of backend security and API integrations.
  • Advanced English proficiency.

Additional Information

About Us

We Are Engineered Different.

At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.

We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.

Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

title: Electrical Engineer
description:

For over 56 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.

The role provides technical analysis and engineering support to ensure compliance with corporate standards, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.

Support FPSO performance and safety by analysing MOCs (Management of Change), TQs (Technical Queries), and NOIs (Notification of Incidents), providing technical recommendations to the operations team;

Develop technicalsolutions and engineering studies related to electrical systems to resolve operational issues onboard the FPSO;

Provide technicalsupport to offshore teams in the implementation of electrical improvements, testing, and system optimization;

Investigate electrical failures and incidents, performing root cause analysis and proposing corrective actions;

Prepare and review electrical engineering documentation such as P&IDs, electrical datasheets, equipment specifications, Cause & Effect diagrams, and electrical SOPs;

Participate in risk assessments (HAZOP, HAZID, HIRA, TRA), ensuring compliance with safety standards and regulations, including NR-10 and NR-12.

Requirements

Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering;

Previous experience in offshore operations (FPSO or oil & gas environment preferred);

Advanced English;

Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail;

Strong analyticaland problem-solving skills;

Solid understanding of offshore oil and gas electrical systems and technologies;

Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and familiarity with electrical, automation, or control engineering software;

Highly effective technical and practical engineering skills with the ability to consistently deliver accurate and timely work.

title: Devops Engineer
description:
We're looking for a DevOps / Cloud Lead who knows how to design, automate, and operate cloud infrastructure. This role focuses heavily on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) due to a strategic partnership in that ecosystem. Many of our clients are migrating infrastructure to OCI or need help operating multi-cloud environments. We need someone who can design solutions, automate processes, and solve infrastructure problems, not just maintain pipelines.Why this role exists We have a strategic partnership with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Clients are asking us to migrate infrastructure to OCI, and many of them also need ongoing DevOps operations and architecture support. We need someone who can own this technically. Not just executing tasks, but executing the task is an important part of the job as well. Design solutions. Talk to clients. Automate migrations. Coordinate engineers. And when necessary, jump in and fix things yourself.TL;
DR You will help lead cloud and DevOps initiatives at Quave. Your job is to: Lead cloud migrations to OCI Design cloud architectures Automate migrations and infrastructure Coordinate DevOps engineers Talk directly to clients Help build repeatable DevOps processes You must be strong in OCI, comfortable with AWS / Azure / GCP, hands-on, obsessed with automation, and comfortable discussing technical architecture with clients. English is a plus, not required.This is not a ticket-based DevOps job If you're looking for a role where you maintain Jenkins pipelines, restart servers, open support tickets, and wait for instructions, this is not the role for you. This role is about designing and solving infrastructure problems. We want someone who can look at a system and think:"We can automate 80% of this." And then actually build the automation.What you'll actually do Cloud Architecture Design infrastructure for systems running in OCI, AWS, Azure, and GCP, migrating from one to another.Cloud Migrations A lot of our work will be migrations like AWS → OCI, Azure → OCI, GCP → OCI. Your job is not just to do the migration, but to help us turn migrations into repeatable processes, scripts, templates, automation and tooling so that each migration becomes easier than the last.Automation We want to automate everything that can be automated: Automated infrastructure provisioning Migration scripts CI/CD pipelines Environment replication Monitoring setups If you like writing scripts that replace hours of manual work, you'll enjoy this role.Client Discussions You will often join calls with clients to understand infrastructure problems, design migration strategies, estimate effort, and propose solutions. You must be comfortable discussing technical topics clearly.Leading DevOps Engineers As the DevOps work grows, you'll coordinate other engineers working on projects, reviewing architecture, guiding implementations, and ensuring quality.What we're looking for You probably have many years working with infrastructure. But more importantly, you have good instincts about systems. You likely: Love automating infrastructure Hate manual processes Can quickly understand unfamiliar systems Are comfortable debugging production environments Enjoy designing architectures Can communicate clearly with both engineers and clients You should also be comfortable using AI tools to accelerate your work. Tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor can dramatically increase productivity when used well. We expect you to take advantage of that.Technical Expectations Cloud Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) - important AWS Azure GCPDevOps Docker Kubernetes Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code tools CI/CD pipelines Linux systems administration Networking fundamentals Automation Comfortable writing scripts in Bash, Python, Go, or similar.Languages Portuguese required. English is a plus as some clients are international, so it may eventually become useful in the future, but it's not required.Why work with Quave We are a small, profitable, independent company. No investors. No corporate bureaucracy. We focus on doing great work for clients and building great software. Things we value: Speed. Quality. Pragmatism. Autonomy. Quave literally stands for Quality (Qua) and Velocity (Ve).Pay and Benefits This is a full-time remote position. Compensation will depend on experience. Fully remote work Flexible hours 22 days paid time off per year Quarterly bonus based on company performance AI allowance for productivity tools We work as a distributed team of independent contractors.Hiring Process Application review Technical conversation Architecture discussion Conversation(s) with one or more partners This is a leadership role and you will coordinate other engineers as the DevOps work grows. But at Quave our leaders are hands-on. You should be comfortable writing automation and infrastructure code yourself when needed.

title: Analista De Sistemas Sr Analytics Engineer - Databricks
description: OGrupo Petrópolisé a única grande empresa do setor cervejeiro com capital 100% nacional. Por meio dos projetos ambientais, promove o plantio e manutenção de milhares de árvores, além de ações de sustentabilidade e programa de educação ambiental para escolas municipais. Essa posição terá papel fundamental na consolidação e evolução da arquitetura analítica baseada em Databricks e Microsoft Fabric, garantindo integração eficiente entre engenharia, modelagem e consumo estratégico de dados. title: Pessoa Coordenadora De Marketing
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.Responsabilidades e atribuições:Coordenação do Departamento de Marketing compreendendo Trade, Comunicação, CRM e Programa de Benefícios;

Responsável pela comunicação do shopping com a assessoria de imprensa: aprovação de releases e sugestão de pautas;

title: Tech Lead Salesforce Developer
description:
